summary: Diagnosed the reconfiguration lag with receipt 55a2acf5c61f4790a32f4db80073d0aa: after 150 fair-delivery rounds (past the 100-tick resend timeout), node 3 was in Accept under leader 4 with promise ballot n=2 but stayed at accepted 37 and decided 37 while the others reached 38. Source shows the repair gap: once the StopSign is decided, resend_messages_leader only resends the Decide, which handle_decide clamps to the follower's accepted index; AcceptStopSign is resent only while undecided, and AcceptSync requires a fresh Promise the stable leader never asks for. Registered the new StopSign-resync question with an executed knowledge fact and a conditional asserted defect claim (stable leader, sealed config, no external reconnect), noting agreement is unaffected and the joint-history reuse of the diagnostic receipt.
